live outbound and inbound kênh directional views

# =============================================================================
# gửi — live outbound and inbound kênh directional views.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Directional kênh views — `gửi<T>` for outbound frames, `nhận<T>` for
#     inbound frames on a kênh connection
#   • Cursor iteration — `lặp từ t.cursor()` consumes inbound frames
#   • Accipe reception — `accipe()` pulls a single khung from the inbound
#     hàng_đợi
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • confusing `gửi` (outbound) and `nhận` (inbound) kênh directional views, or mixing accipe/cursor/exhauri without intentional ordered consumption
#
# See also: gọi, kênh, nhận, khung, con_trỏ, accipe
# =============================================================================

# Live `gửi<T>` / `nhận<T>` directional views
#
# runtime:echo returns one inbound văn_bản frame per conversation.
# accipe, con_trỏ, and exhauri may share one nhận hàng_đợi; mix them only when
# ordered consumption is intentional.

main {
    const kênh s ← call 'runtime:echo' ("salve")
    const gửi<string> m ← s.meus<string>()
    m.da("ping")
    const status outbound ← m.fini()
    const nhận<string> t ← s.tuus<string>()
    for from t.cursor() const frame {
        assert frame.data ≡ "salve"
    }
    const status inbound ← t.fini()
    const kênh s2 ← call 'runtime:echo' ("salve")
    const nhận<string> t2 ← s2.tuus<string>()
    const khung<string> ∪ none got ← t2.accipe()
    const status accipe_done ← t2.fini()
    print outbound
    print inbound
    print got
    print accipe_done
}
